instruction: Stamp Pink using the red seal on rectangular base

source.instruction: Stamp Pink using the red seal on rectangular base

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the seal, which was at x = +8 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper left towards x=9 and forward to y=-9 to approach the seal.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-22, +10, +0) cm, now 12 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the seal

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (9, -9, 94) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper forward to y=1 and rotate roll -84 degrees to orient gripper for grasping the seal.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +10, +0) cm, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the seal

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, 1, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower right gripper to z=81 around seal handle and close gripper to grasp.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +2, -14) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +7 cm (vertical) from the seal; closed the gripper (opening 0.35: holding the seal)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, 2, 81) opening 0.35; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift right gripper slightly to z=86 to check grasp and begin lifting.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +5) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +7 cm (vertical) from the seal

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, 2, 86) opening 0.37; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift further to z=91 and move right gripper to (20, 0) directly over the pink zone.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+12, -2, +5) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +7 cm (vertical) from the seal

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -0, 91) opening 0.37; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower seal to z=83 onto the pink zone and release gripper to stamp.
